topics.title: Citizenship
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Sadi socho — Citizenship hamari zindagi se kaise judta hai? Pakistan / Islamabad context mein seekhein!

## SAMJHAO
Citizenship samjho: yeh Social Studies ka zaroori topic hai. Points: Citizen, Haq, Safai, School rules.

## MISAAL
Misaal Islamabad/Pakistan se: Citizen watan ka hissa. Haqooq aur farz dono.

## KARO
Activity: 3 cheezein likho jo Citizenship se related hon. Ek drawing bhi banao.

## SAWAAL
1) Citizenship kya hai?
2) Ek real-life misaal?
3) Aap citizen ki tarah kya karoge?
